title: Solo RTS across 7 eras: 5 ways to win a battle, from Roman cavalry to 2025 drones
author: kkg7626
selftext:
Yedi Cephe (Seven Fronts) is a real-time strategy game I'm making solo: 7 eras from 200 BC to 2025, 49 playable states. The video shows 5 ways to win a fight:



1. Flank them: cavalry gets behind the line and it collapses

2. Blow the bridge: no crossing, no attack

3. Break through with armor: tanks punch through infantry lines

4. Strike from the air: clumped armies scatter under bombs

5. Hunt with drones: without air defense, you lose the sky



How AI fits in: the 49 unit/state portraits were made with AI image tools and then cleaned up by hand; I also used an AI coding assistant for tooling, tests and these capture/edit scripts (the clips are staged in-engine and recorded frame by frame). Game design, rules and balance are mine.



Free in the browser, no install: [https://kkgturk209.itch.io/yedi-cephe](https://kkgturk209.itch.io/yedi-cephe)



Which tactic would you open with? And for other AI-assisted devs: how do you keep AI art consistent across many factions?
